premises.text: International travelers face a cumbersome process to get their VET refunds
premises.evidence_span: piles of paper that international travelers have to complete in order to get their VET refunds

premises.text: A digital solution can streamline the VET refund process for travelers
premises.evidence_span: Innovat is a digital solution that offers the fastest and easiest VET refund experience for travelers

premises.text: Travelers can receive their refunds through a simple three-step process
premises.evidence_span: Travelers will be able to get their money back in three simple steps. Create a profile, upload the receipt, and get the money back when leaving the country

premises.text: APIs can automate the retrieval of trip details for the refund process
premises.evidence_span: input his trip details, which we automatically locate via APIs with our travel partners

premises.text: Linking a digital VET form to a QR code can facilitate refunds at the airport
premises.evidence_span: We link the digital VET form to the QR code

premises.text: The UK tax-free market is significant and growing
premises.evidence_span: The UK tax-free market is around $4.3 billion, and it is growing 7% year on year

premises.text: Open banking can eliminate the need for travelers to upload receipts
premises.evidence_span: Open banking allows us to read customer transaction data, normalize it, standardize it, and completely eliminate the need of uploading the receipts

premises.text: Innovat can help governments with compliance and fraud elimination
premises.evidence_span: we help them with their compliance systems, and we help them eliminating the fraud

premises.text: Retailers can benefit from customer retention through Innovat's solution
premises.evidence_span: we help with the customer retention, as well as helping them with stepping into the international travelers market

value.text: Travelers can receive their VET refunds quickly and easily

notes: Traction details and personal credentials are excluded as they do not support premises.
